title: CSV Columns
statement:
Read a small table in CSV form and total each of its columns.

The first line is a header of column names separated by commas. Every line after it is a data row with one integer per column, also separated by commas. There is no count line, so keep reading rows until the input ends. There may be no data rows at all, and nothing in the input contains spaces.

For each column, in header order, print one line with the column name, a colon, a space, and the sum of that column's values. A column with no rows sums to `0`.

Input:

```text
apples,pears,plums
3,5,0
10,2,4
1,1,1
```

Expected output:

```text
apples: 14
pears: 8
plums: 5
```
hints: Read the header line first and split it on commas to get the names. Keep one running total per name.
Then read the remaining lines until the input ends. Split each on commas and add value number `i` to total number `i`.
